notes.title: Final Demo released and Kickstarter Campaign is coming!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561335/b4bdaa9bf7bd2513976ac9c0dc60a8061c1fdd90.png"]The final version of the demo is now live!and yes, you can meet Quentin right on Day 1!Thank you all for your feedback and support!
We’ve made many adjustments and improvements based on your suggestions.

Also, our Kickstarter campaign is launching on June 27!
Come support us and help make the full game even richer and more exciting!

Kickstarter campaign https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fymmg/those-npcs-love-stories
